description: Resolve a place the user mentions (station, borough, neighbourhood, postcode, street) to ids. Station lookup forgives spelling (Kings Cross, St James Park, Elephant and Castle) and knows London codes and nicknames (KX, TCR, LST, E&C, ally pally). Returns stations (osm:…, with TfL modes, lines and zone; twin stations such as Hammersmith are listed apart) for find_areas.near_stations, boroughs (uk:borough:…) for find_areas.boroughs, areas and addresses for get_area_overview and assess_listing. Coming soon: until Close Knit opens to assistants this tool answers status coming-soon, no data.
